review.note: Release 0.5.0 requires explicit runtime_sources in pytest_source.main; existing sync regenerates snapshots and each thin caller must declare its owned packages. There is no no-argument fallback, inferred package discovery or application data conversion. Controller and local workers validate the same Python hashes and directory topology, including empty/resource-only namespaces; standard TraversableResources access deliberately leaves resource bytes outside the source-hash guarantee. The pytest assertion installer preserves exactly the registered toolkit finder and runtime finder, including an empty mapping, while ordinary tests/conftests retain rewrite and plain mode. Isolated workers explicitly receive fresh cache settings under -I/-E. All 185 source/entry/bundle regressions passed, including real source/snapshot controller/worker imports, namespace resources, topology drift, unrecorded Python source, post-rewrite mutation and registration rejection. Isolated negative controls against preserved prior source prove both assertion bypass and all three namespace failures. Ruff, formatter, strict mypy and Markdown checks passed; final formal review and full release gate remain independently required. No dependency bounds, pins, runtime dependencies or global tools changed. Fresh registry discovery finds all Python candidates support 3.14 and all Python/Node latest versions satisfy declared ranges. Hatchling 1.32.4, packaging 26.3, build 1.6.1, mypy 2.4.0, pytest 9.1.1, pytest-xdist 3.8.0 and markdownlint-cli2 0.23.3 match the previously reviewed 0.4.0 candidates, so the identical release-note conclusions remain applicable. Ruff alone advanced to 0.17.1. Official https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff/releases/tag/0.17.1 describes preview whitespace-keyword fixes, multiline dedent fixes, PYI/PERF fixes and mutable-container recognition. This repo does not enable preview/PYI/PERF and passes its strict selected rules and formatter with 0.17.1. A fresh normally resolved environment built 0.5.0 project metadata with uv 0.13.0 and these candidates.
